title: Bump @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent to 18.11.0 in the OMP integration
summary: A dependency-only change: the OMP integration's dev dependency on @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent moves from 18.4.5 to 18.11.0, and pnpm-lock.yaml is regenerated to match. The whole @oh-my-pi/* family (pi-ai, pi-agent-core, pi-tui, pi-natives, pi-wire, snapcompact, mnemopi, omp-stats, omptype, pi-catalog, pi-utils) moves in lockstep to 18.11.0, and a handful of transitive packages float up with it: @opentelemetry/* 2.11.0 → 2.12.0, @huggingface/transformers 4.3.0 → 4.3.1, lucide-react 1.51.0 → 1.59.0, ws 8.21.3 → 8.22.0, plus a new @babel/runtime 7.29.10 entry. pi-mnemopi's optional peer on fastembed moves from 2.1.0 to 3.0.0. No source file in the repository changes; the runtime shape of the integration is the same, only the versions of the packages it resolves at install time.

nodes.subtitle: devDependencies
nodes.summary: The only hand-edited file. The dev dependency @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent moves from 18.4.5 to 18.11.0; nothing else in the manifest changes.

nodes.label: OMP integration
nodes.subtitle: integrations/omp
nodes.summary: The integration package itself. Its source is untouched by this change; only the version of the coding agent it develops and tests against moves.

nodes.label: @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent
nodes.summary: The coding agent the OMP integration builds on. Bumped across seven minor versions; it is the root of the whole @oh-my-pi/* cascade in the lockfile.

nodes.label: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core
nodes.summary: Agent loop and tool orchestration, pulled in by the coding agent and by pi-tui. Moves in lockstep with the rest of the family.

nodes.label: @oh-my-pi/pi-ai
nodes.summary: Model/provider layer used by the agent core, the TUI, snapcompact and mnemopi. Version follows the family bump.

nodes.label: @oh-my-pi/pi-tui
nodes.summary: Terminal UI layer of the coding agent; depends on agent core, ai, catalog, natives, utils, wire and snapcompact, all at 18.11.0.

nodes.label: @oh-my-pi/pi-natives
nodes.subtitle: 18.11.0 + platform binaries
nodes.summary: Native bindings package. Its six optional platform binaries (darwin/linux/win32 × arm64/x64) all move to 18.11.0 together.

nodes.label: @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi
nodes.summary: Memory/embedding package. Its optional peer dependency on fastembed moves from 2.1.0 to 3.0.0, the one peer-range change in the diff.

nodes.label: pi-catalog · pi-utils · pi-wire · snapcompact · omp-stats · omptype
nodes.summary: The remaining @oh-my-pi/* packages, all bumped to 18.11.0. omp-stats additionally picks up lucide-react 1.59.0.

nodes.label: @opentelemetry/*
nodes.summary: Context-async-hooks, core, resources, sdk-metrics, sdk-trace, sdk-trace-base and sdk-trace-node all move from 2.11.0 to 2.12.0 under the coding agent. The 0.220.0 exporter packages stay put.

nodes.label: @huggingface/transformers
nodes.summary: Optional dependency of the coding agent, used for local model inference. Patch bump only.

nodes.label: lucide-react
nodes.summary: Icon set used by omp-stats' React UI. Moves from 1.51.0 to 1.59.0.

nodes.label: ws
nodes.summary: WebSocket client pulled in transitively via puppeteer-core. Patch bump.

nodes.label: @babel/runtime
nodes.summary: A second @babel/runtime version appears in the lockfile alongside the existing 7.29.7, now referenced by @testing-library/dom.

The workspace importer entry for integrations/omp in pnpm-lock.yaml mirrors the manifest's dev dependency.

flows.title: How the version bump propagates into the lockfile
flows.summary: Editing one specifier in the OMP manifest forces pnpm to re-resolve the coding agent and everything beneath it, which is why a one-line change produces a 160-line lockfile diff.
